title: 第24章 团聚第25章 洞中屠蛇
slug: 剑里乾坤第3107章不似作伪
content_zh:
老蔡简单的和店里伙计交代了几句，就带着卓然来到一家酒楼，他们一进门，卓然就看见自己母亲坐在柜台里面，正看着客人点的菜单，卓然做个手势给老蔡，让他不要说话，他来到柜台前说道“老板！还有没有雅间了？”高碧柔闻言抬头一看，不由一愣，随即用手指着卓然说道“然儿！然儿！是你嘛？”卓然说道“娘！是我，我回来了！”高碧柔连忙从柜台里面走出来，一把抱住卓然，眼泪就流了下来！卓然也是伸出双手，轻轻的拍了拍高碧柔的后背说道“娘！我饿了！”高碧柔闻言连忙说道“娘这就去安排！你和蔡叔赶紧找地方坐，想吃什么快告诉娘！”卓然说道“随便弄几样就可以了！”高碧柔闻言向后厨走去！
不一会时间，伙计就把四个菜端了上来，吃饭的时候，高碧柔不停的给卓然夹菜，看着卓然狼吞虎咽的，她就在旁边一直看着，饭都忘记吃了！老蔡匆忙吃了点饭就赶回百货店去了，留下高碧柔母子俩在这里说说话。卓然看着母亲说道“娘！您也快点吃东西呀！看我能看饱了呀？”高碧柔微微一笑说道“然儿！让娘好好看看你，我的然儿现在已经变成一个大小伙子了！”卓然夹了一块肉放进高碧柔的碗里说道“娘！您先吃点饭，别饿坏了，我这不回来了吗？”娘俩一边聊着一边吃着饭，基本上都是高碧柔提问，卓然回答。吃完午饭以后，酒楼里面的客人都走了，高碧柔说道“然儿！娘带着你去我们在镇上的新家去看看！”
说完以后她带着卓然出了酒楼，穿过了一条街，没走几步就来到一个四合院门口，高碧柔说道“然儿！这就是我们的新家。”说完以后她来到门口敲了敲门同时她嘴里还喊道“杨妈！开门！”门吱呀一声打开了，一位五十多岁的妇女站在门口说道“夫人！您回来了！”高碧柔指着卓然说道“杨妈！这是我儿子！”杨妈看着卓然弯腰说道“少爷好！”卓然连忙说道“杨妈不用客气！”高碧柔又说道“杨妈！你去把房间收拾一下，晚上给卓然睡觉！”杨妈把门关好以后就去收拾房间去了。
卓然这才仔细打量这个院子，只见一色的青瓦，三间正房，两间厢房分立其侧。一厢为厨，一厢为厅，加上长长的门廊，便浑然一体，巧夺天工。门廊上方，屋脊中央，两片翘瓦拱立，象征着雄鹰展翅，飞黄腾达。四合的小院，平整而洁净。院内花坛，广种花木，与屋前屋后的果树遥相呼应。卓然看完说道“看样子蔡爷爷这百货店生意应该还不错啊！”高碧柔闻言说道“然儿！我们孤儿寡母的，这些年幸亏蔡叔照应着我们，以后你要把蔡爷爷当成亲爷爷一样的孝敬！卓然说道“娘！这还用说嘛？我以后一定会对蔡爷爷和您都很孝顺的！”高碧柔看着卓然笑着点了点头说道“连续赶了不少天的路，累坏了吧？待会去房间休息一下，晚上带上杨妈去酒楼，我们一起吃点饭！”说完她就带着卓然来到杨妈收拾好的房间。这几天卓然确实有点累了！等他进了房间以后，高碧柔这才转身离开。
到了下午天快黑的时候，杨妈就按照高碧柔的吩咐，过来敲门！卓然连忙起来开门，杨妈说道“少爷！夫人让我们这个时间过去酒楼吃饭！”卓然说道“杨妈！以后不要喊我少爷，喊我卓然或者然儿也行！”杨妈连忙说“少爷！这样不好吧？”卓然说道“没有什么不好的，就这样定了！您稍等一下我穿件外套，马上就好！”两人很快来到高碧柔的酒楼，此时正是吃饭的高峰期，酒楼里面已经有不少食客了，店小二在这些食客里面穿插着忙着上菜。高碧柔见卓然和杨妈进来，就让店小二带着他们去了一个雅间，他们刚坐下来时间不长，老蔡就过来了，随即店小二就把他们的菜端了上来，高碧柔也进来坐了下来，老蔡说道“然儿！陪老头子喝两杯啊？”卓然说道“蔡爷爷！您自己喝吧，我不怎么喝酒的！”高碧柔说道“晚上也没有什么事情，你又刚回来，你蔡爷爷高兴，就陪蔡爷爷喝两杯吧！”卓然闻言说道“蔡爷爷！您老的年龄一天一天大了，酒也要少喝一点了！”说完他倒了一杯酒说道“蔡爷爷！我先敬您一杯，祝您老身体健康！”说完他干了这杯酒，老蔡闻言哈哈大笑说道“然儿长大了！懂事了！这杯酒我必须要喝！”说完也是一仰头干了杯中酒，这顿饭大家吃的都很开心，吃完饭以后他们就一起回去了！第二天早上起来以后卓然早早起来练功了，大约一个时辰以后，杨妈喊他吃早餐，在吃早餐的时候，高碧柔说道“然儿！眼看就要过年了，蔡叔和我都挺忙的，你自己安排一下吧，附近都去转转玩玩爬爬山什么的！”卓然说道“娘！您和蔡叔忙你们的，我自己安排！”吃完早餐以后，高碧柔和卓然就去忙了。
卓然吃完早餐以后，又练了一会功夫，然后他和杨妈说了一声，就来到外面转悠了起来，可能要过年的缘故，街道上非常热闹，人来人往，熙熙攘攘，卓然也是随着大伙一起凑热闹，一直到了中午他来到高碧柔的酒楼，吃饭的时候他和高碧柔说道“娘！街道上真热闹啊！我打算明天去爬爬山。”高碧柔微微一笑说道“去吧！好好的玩几天！娘这段时间太忙了，没有时间陪你，再过几天就不会这样忙了！”卓然笑着说道“娘！您就安心赚钱吧！我又不是小孩子了，你儿子又会武功！”高碧柔说道“然儿！你长大了，又学成了本领，每年过年的时候也是娘最痛苦的时候！过完年以后，你就要想办法把这事情查给水落石出，给你爹，你外公外婆，你舅舅，还有那些枉死的冤魂报仇雪恨！”说完眼神坚毅的看着卓然！卓然眼神坚定的看着母亲说道“血债血偿！！
content_en:
Lao Cai briefly explained a few words to the waiter in the store, and then took Zhuo Ran to a restaurant. As soon as they entered, Zhuo Ran saw his mother sitting at the counter, looking at the menu ordered by the customer. Zhuo Ran made a gesture to Lao Cai and told him not to speak. He came to the counter and said, "Boss! Still have it?" Is there room?" Gao Birou looked up and was startled, then pointed at Zhuo Ran and said, "Ran'er! Ran'er! Is it you?" Zhuo Ran said, "Mom, I'm back!" Gao Birou quickly walked out of the counter and hugged Zhuo Ran, crying! Zhuo Ran also stretched out his hands, patted Gao Birou's back gently and said, "Mom! I'm hungry!" Gao Birou heard this and said quickly, "Mom, go make arrangements now! You and Uncle Cai find a place to sit quickly, and tell your mother what you want to eat!" Zhuo Ran said, "Just make a few things!" Gao Birou heard this and walked to the kitchen!
After a while, the waiter brought four dishes. During the meal, Gao Birou kept picking up dishes for Zhuo Ran. Seeing Zhuo Ran gobbling them down, she kept watching from the side and forgot to eat the food! Lao Cai ate some food in a hurry and hurried back to the department store, leaving Gao Birou and her son talking here. Zhuo Ran looked at his mother and said, "Mom! Eat quickly! Do you think I'm full?" Gao Birou smiled slightly and said, "Ran'er! Let Mom take a good look at you, my Ran'er has become a big boy now!" Zhuo Ran put a piece of meat into Gao Birou's bowl and said, "Mom! Please eat some food first, don't be hungry, won't I come back?" The two of them chatted and ate, and Gao Birou basically asked questions and Zhuo Ran answered. After lunch, all the guests in the restaurant left. Gao Birou said, "Ran'er! Mom will take you to see our new home in the town!"
After that, she took Zhuo Ran out of the restaurant, crossed a street, and after a few steps came to the door of a courtyard. Gao Birou said, "Ran'er! This is our new home." After that, she came to the door and knocked on the door. At the same time, she shouted, "Mother Yang! Open the door!" The door creaked open, and a woman in her fifties stood at the door and said "Madam! You're back!" Gao Birou pointed at Zhuo Ran and said, "Mama Yang! This is my son!" Ma Yang looked at Zhuo Ran and said, "Hello, Master!" Zhuo Ran quickly said, "Mama Yang, you're welcome!" Gao Birou said again, "Mama Yang! Go and clean up the room, and let Zhuo Ran sleep at night!" Ma Yang closed the door and went to clean up the room.
Only then did Zhuo Ran look at the courtyard carefully, and saw only blue tiles of the same color, three main rooms, and two wing rooms on its sides. One wing is the kitchen, the other is the living room, and with the long porch, it is integrated and ingenious. Above the porch, in the center of the roof, two warped tiles stand, symbolizing the spread of the eagle's wings and its rapid rise to prominence. The small courtyard in Sihe is flat and clean. The flower beds in the courtyard are widely planted with flowers and trees, echoing the fruit trees in front of and behind the house. Zhuoran read it and said, "It seems that the business of Grandpa Cai's department store should be pretty good!" Gao Birou heard this and said, "Ran'er! We orphans and widowed mothers, fortunately Uncle Cai has taken care of us these years. From now on, you must treat Grandpa Cai as your own grandfather! Zhuoran said, "Mom! Needless to say? I will definitely be filial to Grandpa Cai and you in the future! Gao Birou looked at Zhuoran and nodded with a smile and said, "You have been traveling for many days in a row. Are you exhausted?" Go to the room to have a rest later, and take Yang Ma to the restaurant in the evening. Let’s have some food together! "After that, she took Zhuo Ran to the room that Yang's mother had packed. Zhuo Ran was indeed a little tired these days! After he entered the room, Gao Birou turned around and left.
When it was getting dark in the afternoon, Yang’s mother followed Gao Birou’s instructions and came to knock on the door! Zhuo Ran quickly got up and opened the door, and Yang Ma said, "Master! Madam asked us to go to the restaurant for dinner at this time! "Zhuoran said, "Mother Yang! Don’t call me young master from now on.Just call me Zhuoran or Raner! Yang's mother quickly said, "Master!" Isn't this bad? "Zhuoran said, "There's nothing wrong with it, it's settled! Just wait a moment and I'll put on a coat. I'll be ready soon! "The two came to Gao Birou's restaurant very quickly. It was the peak time for eating. There were already many diners in the restaurant. The waiters were busy serving dishes among these diners. When Gao Birou saw Zhuo Ran and Yang Ma coming in, she asked the waiter to take them to a private room. Not long after they sat down, Lao Cai came over. Then the waiter brought their dishes. Gao Birou also came in and sat down. Lao Cai said, "Ran'er! Want to have a drink with the old man? "Zhuoran said, "Grandpa Cai! You can drink it yourself, I don't drink much! Gao Birou said, "There's nothing going on at night. You just came back. Your Grandpa Cai is happy, so just have a couple of drinks with Grandpa Cai!" Zhuo Ran heard this and said, "Grandpa Cai!" You are getting older day by day, so you need to drink less alcohol! After that, he poured a glass of wine and said, "Grandpa Cai!" Let me toast you first and wish you good health! "After he drank the glass of wine, Lao Cai laughed loudly and said, "But you've grown up! Be sensible! I must drink this glass of wine! "After saying that, he raised his head and drank a glass of wine. Everyone enjoyed the meal. After the meal, they went back together! Zhuo Ran got up early the next morning to practice. About an hour later, Yang's mother called him to have breakfast. While eating breakfast, Gao Birou said, "Ran'er! The Chinese New Year is about to come, and Uncle Cai and I are both very busy. You can make some arrangements yourself and go around the neighborhood to go hiking or something! "Zhuoran said, "Mother! You and Uncle Cai are busy with your work, I will arrange it myself! "After breakfast, Gao Birou and Zhuoran went to work.
After Zhuo Ran finished breakfast, he practiced kung fu for a while, and then he talked to Yang's mother and went outside to wander around. Maybe because of the Chinese New Year, the streets were very lively with people coming and going. Zhuo Ran also joined in the fun with everyone until noon when he came to Gao Birou's restaurant. While eating, he said to Gao Birou, "Mom! The streets are so lively! I plan to go hiking tomorrow. Gao Birou smiled slightly and said, "Go!" Have a good few days! Mom is too busy during this period and has no time to accompany you. In a few days, she won’t be so busy! Zhuoran smiled and said, "Mom!" You can make money with peace of mind! I am no longer a child, and your son knows martial arts again! "Gao Birou said, "Ran'er! You have grown up and learned skills. The Chinese New Year is also the most painful time for your mother every year! After the New Year, you have to find a way to get to the bottom of this matter and avenge your father, your grandparents, your uncle, and those wronged souls who died in vain! After saying that, he looked at Zhuo Ran with firm eyes! Zhuo Ran looked at his mother with firm eyes and said, "Blood debt must be paid with blood!" !
